<\STATESEP>theory Sep_Provers_Example
imports Sep_Provers
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>axiomatization
  Moo :: "'a :: stronger_sep_algebra => bool" and
  Bar :: "'a :: stronger_sep_algebra => bool"
where  Moo_Bar : "Moo s \<Longrightarrow> Bar s"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma "(A \<and>* B \<and>* C \<and>* Bar) s"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. (A \<and>* B \<and>* C \<and>* Bar) s<\STATESEP>apply (sep_rule Moo_Bar)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. (Moo \<and>* A \<and>* B \<and>* C) s<\STATESEP>oops<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma "(A \<and>* B \<and>* C \<and>* Moo) s \<Longrightarrow> R"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. (A \<and>* B \<and>* C \<and>* Moo) s \<Longrightarrow> R<\STATESEP>apply (sep_drule Moo_Bar)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. (Bar \<and>* A \<and>* B \<and>* C) s \<Longrightarrow> R<\STATESEP>oops<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma "(A \<and>* B \<and>* C \<and>* Moo) s \<Longrightarrow> (A \<and>* B \<and>* C \<and>* Bar) s"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. (A \<and>* B \<and>* C \<and>* Moo) s \<Longrightarrow> (A \<and>* B \<and>* C \<and>* Bar) s<\STATESEP>apply (sep_erule_full Moo_Bar)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. \<And>s. (A \<and>* B \<and>* C) s \<Longrightarrow> (A \<and>* B \<and>* C) s<\STATESEP>apply (assumption)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal:
No subgoals!<\STATESEP>done<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>axiomatization where Moo_Bar_R: "(Moo \<and>* R) s \<Longrightarrow> (Bar \<and>* R) s"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma "(A \<and>* B \<and>* C \<and>* Moo) s \<Longrightarrow> (A \<and>* B \<and>* C \<and>* Bar) s"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. (A \<and>* B \<and>* C \<and>* Moo) s \<Longrightarrow> (A \<and>* B \<and>* C \<and>* Bar) s<\STATESEP>apply (sep_erule_full (direct) Moo_Bar_R)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal:
No subgoals!<\STATESEP>done<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
